key.name: default-spacing
key.description: Spacing between screenshots, in pixels, used for every newly created document.

key.name: default-margin-x
key.description: Outer margin left/right of the composition, in pixels, used for every newly created document.

key.name: default-margin-y
key.description: Outer margin above/below the composition, in pixels, used for every newly created document.

key.name: default-export-quality
key.description: JPEG/WebP/AVIF export quality (1-100) used for every newly created document. Ignored for PNG, which is always lossless. Stored as a double (not an int) purely so it can bind directly to AdwSpinRow's "value" property without a custom mapping.

key.name: default-label-style
key.summary: Default label style for new projects
key.description: JSON-encoded label style (position, typography, background, padding, corner radius, shadow) used to seed a brand-new project's own Document::label_defaults when it's created. An empty string falls back to the built-in default style. Purely a starting point: changing this setting never touches any project that already exists — from the moment a project is created, its own label_defaults is completely independent of this key.

key.name: presets
key.description: JSON-encoded list of named style presets (layout, background, shadow, corner radius, global label defaults) the user has saved. Applied through the in-app preset picker rather than any external template file — an empty string means no presets have been saved yet.
